body: Opus2 lesson (2026-11-21): a run's END is only its launcher's terminal END reported by its owner (or read from its results via the owner). Never infer it from a cargo/rustc process disappearing. A FULL's rust stage can end, removing its cargo process, while the same launcher keeps running node stages (freeze, mcp, control, parity, docs). On 2026-11-21 at 18:54Z I saw w-0738's FULL cargo PID gone, assumed the run had ended, and launched B646 R2's LOCAL FULL beside it, breaking the one-Central-cargo-job rule. Merger reported the launcher still running (PID 39916, node freeze stage). Before giving a Central slot, wait for the occupying run's owner to report its terminal END.
